reserveReview.rationale: Observed 2026-10-11T08:53:58Z: the exact-USP Transparency app now exposes issuer-reported token/protocol positions through /api/usp-price. The captured response timestamp is 2026-10-11T08:49:46 (timezone unspecified), supply_eth_block 26168119, total_usp_supply 4375058.729355635798342777 USP, and gross_usdc_value/net_usdc_value 5032237.704851147804231690284. Its 15 token rows plus one Aave protocol row have reported shares summing to 1, but their value_usdc sum is 5033138.5743712674763240782839616175575658, not the reported gross/net USDC book. Material reported token shares include Axis ogUSDx 0.1048887962436935058256028630, Morini StockMarketTRBasisTrade 0.1936762896007510792599155205, its senior tranche 0.1577060671438532551786961477 and junior tranche 0.01964950004293644830202778524, Brix wiTRY 0.1261523499071171049553239677, Accountable Morini aFXArbUSDTRY 0.2721021219444135447488020985, Tori etrUSD 0.1252015676554859052410724648 and USDC 0.0006233018647597816546194191712. These are fractional shares of the reported positions, not independently reconciled whole-USP exposure percentages. The response does not identify token contracts or document exhaustive on/off-chain asset/liability scope or reconciliation adjustments. Overview /api/reserve/distributions instead reports undated target-like percentages and must not replace observed shares. New primary evidence is retained as a diagnostic source, not normalized into a complete composition. The historical unknown strategy envelope, its 2026-08-08 composition date and knownUnknownExposurePct=100 remain until whole-book scope, identities and valuation reconciliation are established; the old secondary split is not adopted.

The complete strategy envelope therefore remains bounded unknown rather than treating reported-position shares as whole-USP exposure weights.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Source-scope correction reviewed 2026-10-20 without renewing the original custody review: Piku now names Fireblocks MPC operational infrastructure and Safe treasury architecture, so the prior blanket statement that no custody identities are disclosed is withdrawn. Those disclosures do not map current whole-book provider shares, exact wallet signing policies or every material underlying strategy custodian. Terms section 4.7 says the Platform holds legal title to USP reserves, does not provide custody services and is not a fiduciary; legal title is not an independent custody attestation or bankruptcy-remoteness instrument. The historical BMMF/operator rows are not a verified current provider census. Whole-book custodyModel is therefore unknown, with no invented provider shares or protective legal safeguards.
